## Core Question {.text-slide .core-question-slide}

<div class="core-question">Where are high-need neighborhoods<br>served by relatively thin pantry infrastructure?</div>

This is a planning tool for outreach and referral targeting.

## The Alignment Problem {.text-slide .alignment-slide}

<div class="alignment-main">Nearby pantry presence does not consistently align</div>
<div class="alignment-sub">with neighborhood food insecurity.</div>

## How the Index Is Built {.text-slide .index-build-slide}

1. Measure tract-level food insecurity
2. Measure 1-mile pantry coverage
3. Standardize and scale to **0-100**

Higher values indicate higher need relative to nearby coverage.

## Need and Pantry Presence Are Weakly Aligned {.chart-slide}

```{r}
#| fig-width: 10.0
#| fig-height: 4.7
#| fig-align: center
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(readr)
  library(scales)
  library(sf)
  library(stringr)
})

normalize_geoid <- function(x) stringr::str_pad(as.character(x), width = 11, side = "left", pad = "0")

fi_raw <- readr::read_csv("../food_insecurity.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
fd_raw <- readr::read_csv("../food_pantry_desert.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
tract <- sf::st_read("../output/stl_food_access_tracts_reporting.gpkg", quiet = TRUE)

fi <- fi_raw %>%
  transmute(GEOID = normalize_geoid(GEOID), prevalence_pct = as.numeric(.data[[names(fi_raw)[2]]]))

fd <- fd_raw %>%
  transmute(GEOID = normalize_geoid(GEOID), desert_raw = as.numeric(.data[[names(fd_raw)[2]]]))

tract_access <- tract %>%
  mutate(GEOID = normalize_geoid(GEOID)) %>%
  filter(grepl("St\\. Louis city|St\\. Louis County", NAME)) %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  transmute(GEOID, pantries_within_1mi = as.numeric(n_pantries_nearby))

scatter_df <- fi %>%
  inner_join(fd, by = "GEOID") %>%
  left_join(tract_access, by = "GEOID") %>%
  mutate(
    fpdi_0_100 = scales::rescale(desert_raw, to = c(0, 100), na.rm = TRUE),
    pantries_within_1mi = ifelse(is.na(pantries_within_1mi), 0, pantries_within_1mi)
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(prevalence_pct), !is.na(fpdi_0_100))

ggplot(scatter_df, aes(x = prevalence_pct, y = fpdi_0_100)) +
  geom_point(color = "#971B2F", alpha = 0.72, size = 2.2) +
  geom_smooth(
    method = "lm",
    formula = y ~ x,
    se = TRUE,
    color = "#1f2937",
    fill = "#cbd5e1",
    linewidth = 0.9
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    name = "Food insecurity (% of adults)",
    breaks = scales::pretty_breaks(6),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.04))
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    name = "Food Pantry Desert Index (0-100)",
    limits = c(0, 100),
    breaks = seq(0, 100, 20),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.04))
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_family = "Avenir Next") +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "#e5e7eb", linewidth = 0.5),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 12, color = "#1f2937"),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 10, color = "#374151"),
    plot.margin = margin(8, 10, 2, 4)
  )
```

High-need tracts do not reliably have more nearby pantries.

## Limits to Keep in Mind {.text-slide .limits-slide}

- Proximity does not capture pantry capacity, hours, or eligibility.
- Location data may be incomplete.
- Use as a planning signal, not a diagnostic tool.
